commits: d7e90bb hud.hpp, 0857e09 test, b20e486 app (draw wraps the HUD; kHudRows kept as the wide HUD for window sizes, hud_px renamed wide_hud_px), f3e0d23 docs
tests: verify.py --frontend --full passed on Arch Linux aarch64 (Asahi), g++ debug/release + clang; suite hud 7 cases, 1952 assertions (the 1-80 column sweep also checks the greedy rule)
manual: tiled under Hyprland at 609x750 (38 columns): HUD 4 rows (status 2, hints 2), every word visible, wrapped at spaces, map below, @ on the centre column; walked 30 turns with run and scent toggled: HUD stayed 4 rows and the map's rows sat at the same pixels before and after; fullscreen (1280 wide, 80 columns): HUD re-flowed to 2 rows identical to before and the view grew; back to tiled: 4 rows again, same as before the resize
perf: key repeat at 38 columns as responsive as at full width
open: at 80+ columns a status line longer than 80 characters (spec time >= 10 ms, 1000+ Dead or a 5-digit miss count) now wraps to a third row instead of clipping, and stays three rows until the width changes; that is the goal (nothing clipped) but differs from 'two rows at 80+'. Before this item it clipped. presentation.md Queue->Done left for completion
